title: Yasaka-dōri, looking east to Yasaka Pagoda
caption: Late afternoon (16:00 JST, sun 231°/11.5°) from OSM way 24516359 at eye height; small granite setts, utility poles (observed on this segment), machiya fronts with kawara hisashi. Cycles render, 3840×2160 source: renders/final_a_yasaka_dori_east.png.

title: Ninenzaka, looking south to its steps
caption: Dusk (16:25 JST) on OSM way 30913263; ishidatami slabs, lanterns and lit shopfronts, the 17-step flight at the far end. Cycles render, 3840×2160 source: renders/final_b_ninenzaka_south.png.

title: Sannenzaka stone stair
caption: Dusk, from the foot of the 46-step flight (OSM way 179116810) looking up-south toward Kiyomizu-zaka. Cycles render, 3840×2160 source: renders/final_c_sannenzaka_stairs.png.

title: Blue hour over the kawara roofs
caption: 14 m above Yasaka-dōri east, looking WNW across the tiled roofs to the illuminated pagoda and the city to the western hills. Cycles render, 3840×2160 source: renders/final_d_bluehour_roofs.png.

title: Yasaka-dōri, the classic view down to the pagoda
caption: Dusk, from the position of the Commons photo 'Gojunoto Tower ... at dusk' (local 91.8, 44.7), looking WNW. Cycles render, 3840×2160 source: renders/final_e_yasaka_dori_upper_west.png.
